title: Ubutware bw'Umuyaga n'Umuriro
intro: Tekereza ubwami aho umuyaga ubwawo wasubizaga umutegetsi umwe, aho amajwi y'ibiremwa bito cyane yaremereye, kandi aho imbaraga zitabonwa n'amaso asanzwe zafatwaga mu buryo bwitondewe. Uyu muntu yarazwe ubwami budasanzwe n'uwamubanjirije, ufite ububasha ku bidukikije n'amajini. Ariko ubutware bukomeye bwaje n'ibigeragezo bikomeye - kandi igihe cya nyuma cyagaragazaga ikintu gitangaje ku miterere y'ubuzima n'urupfu ubwarwo.
clues: Narazwe ubwami bukomeye n'umubyeyi wanjye nkunda cyane, wari n'umuhanuzi akaba n'umugaragu wa Allah.
Imana yampaye ububasha ku muyaga, iwunyohereza mu rugendo rw'ukwezi mu gitondo kimwe.
Ndetse n'inyamaswa ntoya cyane zavugaga uburyo nkora, kandi nahagararaga gato kugira ngo ntangarire ubumenyi bwazo.
Nayoboye ingabo nini cyane z'amajini, abantu n'inyoni, zose ziteguye neza imbere yanjye.
Umutegetsi wa kure yaje kungerageza akoresheje ikibazo gikomeye, maze nterura intebe y'uwo mutegetsi ijya mu rugo rwanjye mbere y'uko umushyitsi ahaguruka ku ntebe.
Nagumye mpagaze, nishingikirije ku nkoni, kugeza igihe ikiremwa gito cyo mu isi cyayiriye — maze abari hafi yanjye bamenya ko nayirenzeho.

arabic: وَلِسُلَيْمَـٰنَ ٱلرِّيحَ عَاصِفَةًۭ تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَـٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا ۚ وَكُنَّا بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And to Solomon [We subjected] the wind, blowing forcefully, proceeding by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And We are ever, of all things, Knowing. (21:81)
